## Description

Combines rough path signature tensor embeddings with Neural Delay Differential Equations to model time-lagged memory effects in cointegrated asset spread trajectories for statistical arbitrage.

## Where it may fit

Statistical arbitrage with time-lagged transmission, cointegrated asset pairs with macro policy delay transmission.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Hedge Funds, Quantitative Equity Desks.

## Required data

High-frequency tick or bar price series of paired assets, policy announcement delay schedules.

## Caveats

Requires GPU acceleration for signature tensor transformations and delay differential equation solving.
